baseline: PLMR_Website_v18.zip + approved optional legacy-image uploader fix
binding_points: Required startup images on first/incoming page
Contact form fetch and JSON result processing
unknown_progress_policy: No percentage; narrow waiting movement on first slope, no apparent route completion

behavior.method: Node VM, deterministic time and DOM/event fixtures; no live email or browser navigation

results.name: Short load never becomes visible; end clears all decorative work
Original bitmap first, continuous morph after 1 second, rider after morph
Measured 0-100 route; stalled progress freezes wheels and pedals without RAF
Measured movement also moves pedals; invalid totals do not create false percentages
Completion is immediate and does not impose a minimum display duration
Background tab stops all decorative timers and frames; resume and reset are safe
Reduced motion leaves original logo and text with no bicycle or animation work
Rapid navigations/back-forward lifecycle and concurrent tasks never leave stale indicators
Visible critical startup image resolves or fails without waiting for background media
Stuck startup image has a 15-second nonblocking fail-safe and removes image listeners
Form success/error preserve existing feedback and re-enable retry; no real message is sent
Form connection failure and 45-second abort remove loader and keep fallback/retry
Clipboard success and timeout cleanup, including selected-text fallback
Video metadata and pause stay quiet; real playback waits locally, ends on playing/error
Failed video buffering stops decorative animation after 30 seconds; native player stays intact
Loading component failure is isolated from contact delivery and site initialization

results.check: 30 HTML pages: content, anchors, downloads, target/rel and fragment links unchanged; loader included once
Existing logo and media bytes, downloads, original stylesheet, Worker and hosting configuration unchanged
1,001 positions: no L/R contact, head always above the mountain including valley, within SVG bounds
Responsive width constraints for 320/375/390/768 px; transparent, nonblocking SVG; no document scroll/focus lock
results.method: CSS constraints + SVG geometry bounds; not browser layout measurement

results.check: No link interception, history replacement, navigation timeout, download interception or artificial operation delay

static_and_geometry.browser_limit: Cloud browser refused local test URL by URL/security policy; no live browser layout/history test was performed.

visual_qa.method: Production-generated SVG frames rasterized with Sharp/librsvg; visual inspection

verification_limits: No real browser history/navigation or CSS layout test: cloud browser rejected local QA URL
PowerShell uploader not executed in Windows

timeout_note: Interrupted/timed-out form requests explicitly report that delivery could not be confirmed, without claiming the server sent nothing.
